title: Weekly status report – release 3.2

definitions.meaning: Milestone reported as done by the responsible team lead in the Monday update round.
Schedule on track; no escalation requested by any team lead.

context_note: Compiled from team inputs received by Mon 10 Mar 16:00. Prepared for internal circulation ahead of the external review on Tue 11 Mar 11:00.
content:
OVERALL STATUS: GREEN. Release 3.2 of the customer self-service portal is CONFIRMED for go-live on Monday 17 March.

Milestones. Development complete: Confirmed. Billing API v2 integration: Confirmed. Data migration rehearsal: Complete (run on 6 March, 0 critical defects). User acceptance testing (UAT) with customer testers: scheduled 12–14 March. Go/no-go meeting: 14 March 15:00.

Risks. R-11 customer UAT tester availability: Medium, mitigated by recorded walkthroughs. R-14 payment-gateway TLS certificate renewal: Low, handled by Infrastructure. No High risks open.

Summary for external review: release 3.2 is on track and confirmed for 17 March. No decisions required from the customer.
